title: Reacting thermals hold at 1.5x resolution, run steady to T=2000, and a local fuel cut starves only the caps in its strip: interim controls for 20261027T0040-c49-reacting-thermals-claim
summary: world.py adds two switches to the claim's world (defaults unchanged): dx (grid spacing) and a local cut (fuel held at 0 in a vertical strip from cut_t). 1.5x resolution (dx 2/3, 192^2, same physical box, seeds 0 and 1): persistent splits 66 and 75, generation 11 and 8, dividing caps that travel >= 3 sqrt(area) between their own birth and division 34/48 and 33/51 (14/48, 13/51 in long axes); the population is denser than at 128^2 (36-40 vs 20-30 bodies). Long run (seed 0, T=2000): 78 persistent splits, 22/30 dividing caps pass, the population stays at ~20-27 caps from t=400 to 2000 (pack_long/sheet.png), so losses balance fission. Local cut at t=400 (cut.py): a strip one cap wide plus 4 px (9 and 8 px) on the cap with the most horizontal clearance; caps inside the strip 1 -> 0 (seed 0) and 4 -> 0 (seed 1) within 2 t and none survive to t=480, while the fed twin keeps 0-5 inside and the caps outside the strip stay at 0.9-1.3x their t=400 number in both arms (cut_s0.png, cut_s1.png).

finding.operator: burning heat source in a Boussinesq fluid (buoyancy torque g dT/dx) on a fast-diffusing regrowing fuel
finding.control: local supply cut (fuel held at 0 in a vertical strip on one cap's path) with the fed twin branched at the same state, seeds 0 and 1; plus a 1.5x resolution continuation and a T=2000 run for M and D
finding.result: caps in the strip 1 -> 0 and 4 -> 0 within 2 t, none to t=480 (fed: 0-5 inside); outside the strip 0.9-1.3x in both arms; resolution 1.5x: 66/75 persistent splits, M-before-division 34/48 and 33/51; T=2000: 78 persistent splits, steady ~25 caps

limits: The local cut is a firebreak: anything that enters the strip goes out, so the 'one individual' is the 1-4 caps in the strip, and dependence of heat on fuel is by construction (heat is made only by burning). Body density changes with resolution (not converged), though every qualitative behaviour holds. No deaths ledger: the tracker breaks thin arcs into fragments (~1000 nucleations in the long run), so births and deaths are not counted one by one. Gravity still sets the direction of travel.
